outcome: APPV detection by RT-qPCR in oral fluid, serum, and nasal swabs
Immune response (antibody detection) to recombinant APPV Erns, E2, or NS3 antigens via indirect ELISAs in serum and oral fluids
cohort: The study participants were 22 cesarean-derived, colostrum-deprived pigs.
finding: Both oral fluid and serum APPV Erns ELISAs were effective for evaluating individual and herd APPV status, with oral fluid antibodies detected earlier (14 dpi) than serum antibodies (24 dpi), and the Erns ELISA outperforming other targets.
